brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Closed enclosure – fully enclosed body to house a board
requirements.evidence: Single full hex base piece:0,0,0;full with solid top cover cover:0,0,0;full;top and 6 solid end caps on bearings 30/90/150/210/270/330. No open faces remain (check_build ok, meshClash clear). Forms a sealed 220×218×80mm box.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so the board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: Port louvre port:0#0,0#0 (hex-port-louvre) fitted in side slot 0 of piece:0,0,0;full. Louvre vents the closed cell without letting rain in per catalog.

finish.summary: Closed single-cell hex enclosure built from one full base, solid top cover and six solid caps, with a hex-port-louvre in one side port to ventilate. lockJoints applied, check_build clear, staged with multimeter on lid to show electronics use.

events.text: Building your vented electronics enclosure — I'll craft a closed, breathable box for the board.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

events.text: I've confirmed your vented enclosure is feasible — now I'll assemble the sealed body with breathing vents.

parts.name: Port plug
parts.use: Blanks a side port you are not using, so a cell that is closed up looks finished and nothing gets in through a hole you left open.

parts.name: Port louvre
parts.use: Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe can still stand outside.

parts.name: Port screen
parts.use: Passes air and keeps insects and debris out, so a cell can breathe through an opening that is still covered.

parts.name: Port hose barb
parts.use: Lands a hose on a cell, so water arrives and leaves through a spigot drawn for it rather than over an edge.

parts.name: Port cable plate
parts.use: Leads cable through a side port on finished holes, so wiring enters a closed cell through something drawn for it and each run has its own way in.

events.text: I've mapped the key components for your enclosure — now I'll design the closed box with that crucial vent.
